description: Haditha Dam observations on the Euphrates in Iraq span June 1989 to September 2024, with 12,903 daily records. Variables include reservoir level, upstream and downstream stages and estimated storage. This resource is provided by Nazhon Khaleel. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC0 1.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Storage is estimated, and metadata alone does not establish measurement accuracy or gap treatment. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
